resources.string: ARCore uses the camera to understand the environment and detect the image markers. Without this permission the Augmented Reality mode cannot start.

Name the marker and pick one of the options: \"Create marker\" draws a new pattern in the app and saves the PNG for printing; \"Load marker\" uses an image already on the device (with no name typed, the file name is used as the label).

The system picker opens with no type filter: Android does not know the types of .glb, .obj and .ply files and, with a filter, they would appear greyed out. Pick the model file — the app checks the extension and explains when the format is not supported.
Supported formats: .glb, .gltf (glTF 2.0), .obj, .stl, .ply and .3mf. The .dae (COLLADA) format is not supported: convert it to .glb.

1. LOAD THE MODEL
Tap the button in the bottom right corner (Load 3D model) and pick a .glb, .gltf, .obj, .stl, .ply or .3mf file. The .dae (COLLADA) and .fbx formats are not supported — convert them to .glb (Blender: File ▸ Export ▸ glTF 2.0). Models exported from CAD/SketchUp are usually in millimetres and the app scales them automatically; models with thousands of parts take tens of seconds to load (the status bar tells you).

2. CHOOSE OR CREATE THE MARKER
In the bottom bar, tap the QR code icon (Manage marker) and then Create/Load marker:
• Create marker: type a name and the app draws the pattern, saves it as a marker and exports the PNG to Pictures/ArkZ ARModelViewer/Marcadores — print it 15 cm wide.
• Load marker: use an image already on the device (photo, screenshot, QR code).

3. POINT THE CAMERA
Point at the printed image from 30–60 cm, with good lighting, avoiding glare, folds and very shallow angles. The image should fill a good part of the frame. With no model loaded a cyan cube appears on it — that is the indicator that detection is working.

4. ADJUST THE MODEL
In the Model adjustments panel (the controls icon in the bar): rotation X/Y/Z (0°, 0° and 0° by default), size (largest dimension, in metres) and Elevation Z (moves the model away from or towards the marker plane). On screen, pinch also changes the size and the auto-scale button fits the model to the marker width.

5. CAPTURE THE SCREEN
The camera button saves the current view (camera + model, without the interface) to Pictures/ArkZ ARModelViewer, playing the shutter sound.

OTHER TIPS
• Restart (first button in the bar) drops the detections and returns rotation, size and elevation to the defaults.
• If a model does not show up, Logcat explains why: adb logcat -s ArkZARModelViewer
